speak.title: Role-play: is this video really healthy?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your friend follows a wellness creator who sells supplements and says people should skip meals. You're worried. Ask who earns money from the posts, and suggest a better way to get advice.

b.role: the friend who follows the creator
b.text: You enjoy the creator's videos and feel more motivated. Explain what you like about them. Listen to your friend, then decide if you'll change anything.

phrases: I'm a bit worried about those videos.
I don't think it's that simple.
That's a fair point, but I'd still check it.
It's just a routine, it's not a big deal.
Could we ask a doctor together?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the friend change their mind, and what would you do next?
